provenance.procedure: GET /movie/4040?append_to_response=external_ids with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 contract (ADR-0026) because CI has no token and none may be committed. Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb movie-4040.
provenance.note: Synthesised: TMDB's 404 for an id it does not have (status_code 34). A Work carrying a tmdb id that no longer resolves must come back as found=false — the modelled 'no such title' — not as a transport error the worker would retry forever.

response.body: {"success":false,"status_code":34,"status_message":"The resource you requested could not be found."}
